known_issues: buildByteSeries and its three byte-series tests were removed rather than left unwired, because a pure function with no production caller is dead code. The series reduction it introduced (even stride, first and last kept) is carried over verbatim into buildSignalSeries, and the count is reconciled in the phase report.

LivePlotPanel still subscribes to the shared realtime store for the stream identity it uses as the chart key, even though every plotted value now comes from the decoded store. That subscription is deliberate - it keeps the panel a subscriber of the one pipeline rather than a second one, and it is what makes a stream epoch rebuild the chart instead of carrying a curve across two numberings.
